patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layouts are used for showcasing work, combining full-bleed images of varying sizes to create dynamic visual interest.
Extremely large, stacked, and somewhat abstract sans-serif typography is used as a primary design element in the hero section and footer, creating a bold, almost sculptural presence.
A high-contrast, minimalist palette of black, white, and dark grey is punctuated by a single vibrant accent color (red/pink) used sparingly for visual impact.
The initial dark hero section scrolls out of view to reveal a lighter background with a glowing element, while the navigation bar sticks to the top and transforms its background from dark to light.
Content sections are separated by ample vertical whitespace and distinct background shifts, maintaining a clean and airy feel despite the bold typography.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky navigation bar that changes its background color and text color from dark to light as the user scrolls past the initial hero section. The hero section itself appears to be a full-screen video or image that scrolls out of view, revealing the main page content beneath it. Subsequent content sections reveal from the bottom of the viewport as the user scrolls, without complex individual section animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, stacked sans-serif hero text (~8x body) with a clear hierarchy to smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp, with all elements featuring crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of extremely large, stacked typography in the hero and footer, which functions as a primary visual element rather than just text. This, combined with a stark, high-contrast palette and minimalist layout, creates a bold and almost artistic brand presence that feels more like a gallery than a typical agency site.
